profile_text.body:
Palo Alto Networks is a publicly traded cybersecurity company (Nasdaq: PANW, CIK 0001327567) that describes itself as a leader in cybersecurity protection and software for modern enterprises. Its site positions the company as serving a range of security practitioners, including CISOs, network security engineers, cloud architects, and SOC managers, with offerings spanning network security, cloud workloads, hybrid workforce protection, threat intelligence, and security consulting.

The company's AI product tracked by this site is Precision AI, described as a network security AI system with Zero Trust integration, autonomous threat response capabilities, and applicability to critical infrastructure. The site also references the Strata Network Security Platform, described as built for Zero Trust and powered by AI to monitor, analyze, and prevent threats in real time, as well as an AI-driven SecOps platform for security operations center transformation. A product called Idira is introduced on the site as a next-generation identity security platform aimed at securing identities for AI enterprise environments.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings beyond the company's public registration are reflected in the held facts for this entry.
